# The kernel of reduction modulo $p^i$

For $i\in\mathbb N$, the kernel of reduction $q_i:\mathbb Z_p\to\mathbb Z/p^i\mathbb Z$ modulo $p^i$ is $H_i$.

*Proof sketch.* The kernel of reduction is the ideal generated by $p^i$, which is $\{a : p^i\mid a\}=H_i$.
